title.narrative: Real-Time Price and Inflation Tracker for Moldovan Audiences

description.narrative: Frontier Tech Hub, funded through the FCDO, has been delivering work to explore the role of technology in tackling mid/dis information. In addition to Frontier Tech Hub funding for two mis/dis pilots from January – March 2026. Additional funding from FCDO’s Eastern Europe and Central Asia (EECAD) has been awarded to conduct a pilot to develop a real-time price and inflation tracker in Moldova.The project will deliver an AI-powered interactive widget embedded on NewsMaker.md, supported by regular explanatory content via newsletters and social platforms. The tool will automatically collect and process verified data from trusted public institutions, including the National Bureau of Statistics of Moldova, the National Bank of Moldova, and the National Energy Regulatory Agency. Where technically feasible, the system may also integrate anonymised price data from online marketplaces and supermarkets to enrich the analysis.The core objective of the project is to improve public understanding of economic trends by making reliable data visible, accessible, and directly connected to everyday experience. The tool will track headline inflation, price dynamics for a defined basket of essential goods (such as bread, milk, sugar, fuel, and energy), and average salary levels across the economy. By visualising how these indicators move together over time, the project enables audiences to interpret economic change based on evidence rather than speculation or propaganda
